name: SQL Database
description: Execute SQL queries on PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQLite databases. Supports SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE.

properties.name: connectionString
properties.description: Database connection string or file path for SQLite

properties.name: query
properties.description: SQL query to execute. Use ? for parameters.

properties.name: data
properties.description: Data to insert/update (object or array of objects)

properties.name: parameters
properties.description: Parameters for ? placeholders in SQL query. Will be bound in order.

meta.author: Nodify System
meta.notes: Template implementation. Install database drivers for production: better-sqlite3, pg, or mysql2
